correctness.rationale: Using the published all-graph 3-state circulation theorem, extinction iff no initial rainbow triangle because triangles span integer cycles in complete r-partite graph with r>=4 (chordless 4-cycles can be coned to a third part). A rainbow triangle forces perpetual GHM excitation, and all zero-circulation initial states synchronize to the unique all-rest fixed state. Rainbow triangle presence is equivalent to an SDR for the three colour supports among matched pairs. Hall fails exactly if a colour is absent (3*4^r-3 states) or all colours occur but two occupy exactly one pair (6r extra states). Those are disjoint, giving the exact new all-r basin and probability. New independent full-trajectory/rainbow checks r=3,4,5 reproduce the formula, including r=4 789 and r=5 3099. Repaired scientific files contain full proof/scope and no claim to novelty for prior P_r/C_r formulas.

final_claim: REPAIRED AND NARROWED: On the cocktail-party graph K_{2,...,2} with r>=4 matched pairs, the synchronous 3-state Greenberg–Hastings fixed-state extinction basin has exactly Z_r=3*4^r-3+6r labelled initial colourings, while the complementary nonextinction basin has B_r=9^r-Z_r. For uniform initial colourings, P(extinction)=3*(4/9)^r+(6r-3)/9^r, asymptotic to 3*(4/9)^r. Its exact colour-Hall obstruction proof is the novel claim; previously known three-cycle and periodic-point counts are explicitly credited and removed as claimed results.
